info.title: Home Assistant REST API
info.description: Plugin-maintained description of the documented Home Assistant REST API. Available integrations and service schemas depend on the connected instance. All operations require a bearer access token.

post.description: Waits for service execution. Response data requires ?return_response. A service that requires response data returns 400 if the flag is absent; a service without response support returns 400 if it is present.

parameters.description: Request response data from a service that supports it. Presence enables this option, even with an empty value; omit the parameter to disable it.

200.description: Intent response, including speech, cards, and structured success or error data.

post.description: Requires the intent integration. Data maps slot names to raw values. Intent handling failures may be returned as HTTP 200 with response_type set to error.

bearerAuth.description: Home Assistant access token (OAuth access token or long-lived access token).

state.description: State values are strings, including numeric sensor readings.

force_update.description: Emit a state change even if the value is unchanged.

services.description: Current releases return a map of service names to metadata; older releases returned a list of names.

entity_id.description: Target entity ID or IDs, when accepted by the selected service.

ServiceCall.description: Service-specific data is supplied directly in this object. Accepted fields and required values depend on the domain and service; discover metadata with GET /api/services.

HistoryState.description: Historical state. Intermediate records with minimal_response may have only state and last_changed; no_attributes omits attributes.

BadRequest.description: Invalid request, parameters, or service data.

Unauthorized.description: Bearer token is missing or invalid, or the user lacks permission.

Forbidden.description: The authenticated user is not permitted to perform this operation.

NotFound.description: The requested entity, resource, or integration endpoint is unavailable.

MethodNotAllowed.description: The HTTP method is not supported for this resource.

ServerError.description: Home Assistant could not complete the operation.
